items.title: NextEra Energy (NEE) Pushes Back On 60 Day Merger Review Delay
items.summary: NextEra Energy (NYSE:NEE) and Dominion Energy have opposed a request from state attorney generals and advocacy groups for a 60 day extension to comment on their major merger application. The companies told federal regulators that the size of the transaction does not change the standard review period or analysis and pointed to prior large deals reviewed within typical timelines. items.title: NextEra Energy (NEE) Faces Maryland Challenge In Federal Merger Review
items.summary: NextEra Energy (NYSE:NEE) faces new regulatory attention as Maryland's Office of People's Counsel moves to join federal review of its proposed merger with Dominion Energy. The state watchdog is seeking participation in Federal Energy Regulatory Commission proceedings to assess potential effects on competition in the PJM regional power market. Consumer advocates in Maryland aim to examine how the transaction could influence electricity prices, service reliability, and market concentration...
